name: UPDC Plc
source: Audited group statements of UPDC Plc: FY2025 and FY2024 from the audited financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025 (signed 26 March 2026); FY2023 and FY2022 from the Annual Report and Financial Statements 2023 (Deloitte, audited); FY2021 from the restated comparative in the 2022 Annual Report. Figures printed in N thousands and stored here in naira. Net Profit is profit attributable to equity holders of the parent, so profit before tax less income tax equals profit for the year before non-controlling interests, not the Net Profit row. FY2021 Net Margin and Operating Margin are withheld because the FY2021 result carries a discontinued operation loss on a small revenue base, which puts the margin outside a plausible band.

rows.label: Cost of Sales
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity Revenue - Cost of Sales = Gross Profit, and the column ties with it positive
rows.source: stockanalysis.com NGX income statement, calibrated to this file's own stored values

rows.label: Gross Profit
rows.derivedFormula: Gross Profit = Revenue - Cost of Sales
rows.derivedCellFormula: Gross Profit = revenue - costOfSales, computed from the values this file already stores

marketCapSource: NGX 'List of Equities as of 2026-04-09' (doclib.ngxgroup.com), shares outstanding
reconciliation_note: Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT) does not hold in FY2025, FY2024: the filed operating profit is a subtotal that also carries operating income not shown as a separate row in this file, and it ties forward to Profit Before Tax. The figure is corroborated by the statement's own bridge and is shown unchanged.
derivedCellsNote: Individual blank cells derived from the same file own printed inputs, each tagged derived true with its formula and identity agreement rate.
nameNote: the statement carried only its ticker as the name; the name is taken from the exchange listing for UPDC
